Special Support Library (ss.library), version 5.1
(c) 1993-1995 Martin Mares, MJSoft System Software

   The Special Support Library is a small library written to simplify
development of small assembly programs. These programs usually contain
small routine, which is preceeded by some sort of startup code for argument
parsing, WB startup, opening of required libraries and similar actions.
With SSLib, you include only a significantly less piece of code for loading
of the library (this startup is usually generated by the "start" macro in
ssmac.h).
   But SSLib is very useful not only for small programs, but also for large
projects, because it offers a very powerful object tracking mechanism based
on ideas of the arp.library.

>> Zna li neko kako da odredim koja je od dve  űboje svetlija na osnovu
>> njihovih R, G i B komponenti?

Teško ćeš to odrediti pomoću RGB komponenti, jer one u sebi ne sadrže tu
informaciju. Svaka komponenta predstavlja udio jedne od osnovnih boja u
boji koja se dobija, a u njima osvijetljenost nije definisana.

Ono što tražiš ćeš dobiti pomoću HSV komponenti, konkretno pomoću
komponente V (value). Što je vrijednost manja, boja je tamnija; veća
vrijednost predstavlja svijetliju boju.

ImageStudio, shareware image processing and conversion package for the
Amiga.

   Copyright (C) 1994,1995 Andy Dean, Graham Dean.

Machine requirements
====================

   ImageStudio requires the following system to run:

   * Workbench 2.04 or above.

   * Around 1 megabyte of free memory.

   * Several megabytes of free hard disk space.

   If ImageStudio is run on an AGA machine (A1200 or A4000), it will
use the new display modes and palette routines to improve the quality
of the internal viewer images.

Brief description
=================

   ImageStudio is written for the casual graphics user who wishes to
convert or manipulate various graphics formats on a modest Amiga
system. There are several commercial offerings available, however the
casual user is paying a lot of money for many facilities and options
they would probably never use.

   Bitmap graphics, by their nature, usually require large amounts of
RAM. One of the main objectives of ImageStudio was to reduce this
burden by utilising virtual memory - most users have more spare hard
disk space than spare RAM.

   ImageStudio works with several buffers at any one time (dependant on
how many levels of undo are specified), each of these buffers can hold
either colour-mapped or 24-bit images. For a detailed description of
colour-mapped and 24-bit images, See Image types.

   ImageStudio comes with a fully featured ARexx port, which allows the
writing of macro scripts to automate repetative processes and also
allows communication with other ARexx aware programs. Again, ARexx has
the reputation of being "something pretty difficult", so we've
simplified the use of ARexx in ImageStudio by allowing the user to
create, edit and run scripts entirely within ImageStudio - ImageStudio
even provides a blank template as a starting point for each new script.

List of features
================

   General:
   * Full 24-bit image buffers, with optimizations for colour-mapped
     (palette based) images.

   * Up to 100 levels of undo / redo.

   * User configurable virtual memory.

   * Fully font sensitive, style guide complient, user interface.

   * Fully featured, easy to use, ARexx interface.

   * Modular loaders and savers.

   * User saveable preferences.

   * Operations applicable to the whole image or a selected region.

   * Up to 256 greyshade preview window (with optional dither).

   * Zoom on preview window.

   * Internal / external viewers (external for third party 24-bit
     graphics cards).

   * Loading / saving / manipulating of AGA image formats (e.g. 256
     colours, HAM8) on non-AGA machines.

   * Max image size of 32000 x 32000 (crops images to 250 x 250 in the
     unregistered version).

   * Copy / paste to / from the system clipboard.

   * Runs on all Workbench 2.04+ Amiga's - utilises AGA chipset if
     available.

   * Online AmigaGuide help, as well as ASCII, TeX `.dvi' and
     PostScript documentation.

   * Multi-level help error requesters.

   * Public screen.

   * Requires no third party libraries or utilities.

   Import:
   * IFF-ILBM formats (Standard palette based, HAM6, HAM8, extra
     halfbright, ILBM24)

   * BMP

   * GIF (conforming to GIF87a or GIF89a)

   * JPEG (conforming to JFIF standard)

   * PCX

   * Targa

   Export:
   * IFF-ILBM formats (Standard palette based, HAM6, HAM8, extra
     halfbright, ILBM24)

   * BMP

   * EPS

   * GIF (conforming to GIF87a or GIF89a)

   * JPEG (conforming to JFIF standard)

   * PCX

   * Targa

   Colour Balance:
   * All operations are available to the R,G,B components separately.

   * Brightness ( upto Š100%)

   * Contrast (non to full)

   * Gamma ( + and - )

   Convolution:
   * Many supplied convolution filters.

   * User definable convolutions, load and save to disk.

   Effects:
   * Built in effects: Dynamic range expansion, FlipX, FlipY, RollX,
     RollY, Negative, Greyscale, Highlight, Shadow, Random, Pixelize,
     Remove isolated pixels.

   Scale:
   * Crop to selected region.

   * Increase / decrease scale by percentage or absolute image size.

   * Simple scale or colour averaged.

   Colour reduction:
   * Increase colour mapped images to 24-bit.

   * Decrease number of colours in 24-bit or colour mapped images via
     Heckbert median cut algorithm.

   * Dithers available for colour reduction: None, Floyd-Steinberg,
     Burkes, Stucki, Sierra, Jarvis, Stevenson-Arce.

   Palette:
   * Edit palette colours and ranges.

   * Save current palette.

   * Force palette onto current image, dithering if necessary (all
     dithers available).

Shareware version
=================

   To encourage users to register, the freely distributable version of
ImageStudio will crop images to 250x250 pixels. All other operations
are available.

This demo version of RayStorm is limited to a resolution of 160x128 pixel.
The full version is unlimited (see manual for informations how to register).

(2) 881-version: 68020 processor and a mathematical coprocessor

(2) 020-version: 68020 processor (no math coprocessor needed)

(4) 000-version: 68000 processor (should even run on a Amiga 500
    (not tested))

(5) 1MB RAM minimum

(6) RayStorm was written using MUI. So you need muimaster.library V2.3 or
    later to run RayStorm.

recommended: 68030, 68882, Harddisk, GFX-Board

  Imagine. It can load Imagine objects and use Imagine textures.

- Color, reflectivity, filter, altitude and specular mapping.
- Flat, cylinder and sphere mapping.
- Soft brush mapping.

- 8 levels of antialiasing (adaptive supersampling).

- Three light types: ambient, point and spot.
- Depth of field with adjustable focal distance and aperture.
- Soft shadows.

- Material attributes for realictic objects: ambient color, diffuse color,
  specular color, specular reflection exponent, diffuse transmission color,
  specular transmission color, specular transmission exponent, specular
  transmittance, transparent color, reflective color, index of refraction,
  foglength.
- Bright objects.
- Motion blur for realistic animations.
- Quick rendering.
- Global reflection map.
- Image formates: IFF-ILBM, PNG, TGA and Datatypes.
- Object format: Imagine-TDDD, 3DS

       Pa, normalno je da tolike slike zauzimaju toliko prostora. Veličina
slike (u bajtovima) računa se tako što se pomnože dimenzije slike sa
rezolucijom i veličinom "palete". Npr. slika formata 13x18cm skenirana u
rezoluciji 300 dpi (oko 120 tačaka po cm) sa 16,7 mil. boja (24bitna paleta -
dakle 3 bajta po pikselu) zauzeće oko 13x18x120x120x3 tj. približno 10 MB.
Slike koje obično gledamo na našim monitorima su znatno manje rezolucije -
recimo 640x480, naspram 1560x2160 za gore pomenutu skeniranu fotografiju.
Pored toga, broj boja je često znatno manji - npr. GIF format je ograničen na
256 boja (8 bita) što znači da takva slika zauzima tri puta manje memorije.
         Osim toga, većina popularnih formata (kao što su IFF, TIFF, GIF, i,
pogotovu JPEG) podržava kompresiju slike, tako da npr. JPEG slika veličine
50-ak KB kada se raspakuje može da zauzme i preko 1MB. Kada smo već kod
kompresije treba spomenuti da neki formati (npr. JPEG) koriste tzv. "lossy"
kompresiju, tj. neke informacije iz slike se svesno zanemaruju da bi se
povećao stepen kompresije, čime, jasno, slika gubi na kvalitetu. Zato ne
treba preterivati sa kompresovanjem da se ne bi dobile slike kakve viđamo po
raznim domaćim BBS-ovima a koje su često vrlo jadnog kvaliteta.

+> Da li neko zna kako se montira dodatni hard disk na Amigu 1200?

    Šta  podrazumevaš  pod  'dodatni'?  Drugi? Pre svega, zavisi od tipa
interfejsa - IDE ili SCSI.
    Ako  se  radi  o dva IDE diska, prvo što je potrebno je odgovarajući
kabl.  U  zavisnosti od veličine prvog diska (2.5" ili 3.5") potreban je
kabl  koji ima jedan 3.5" i dva 2.5" konektora, odnosno jedan 2.5" i dva
3.5"  konektora (za 3.5" hard diskove). U ovom drugom slučaju, mislim da
je  najjednostavnije  uzeti  hard  disk  kabl  sa PC-ja (on ima tri 3.5"
konektora)  i  umesto jednog 3.5" zalemiti 2.5" konektor. Ne znam kolika
je  maksimalna  dozvoljena dužina kabla, ali ne bi trebalo preterivati i
stavljati kabl duži od 1m.
    Dalje,   kabl   se  može  sprovesti  izvan  kućišta  kroz  otvor  za
ekspanzioni  slot  na  zadnjoj  strani  A1200 (pored konektora za miša i
džojstik  -  poklopac se skida pomoću malog šrafcigera). Druga mogućnost
(znatno  manje  preporučljiva)  je  kroz otvor za PCMCIA slot. Na kraju,
potrebno   je  obezbediti  kućište  za  disk  i  napajanje  -  1200-tkin
ispravljač ni u snu ne bi mogao da izdrži dva hard diska, a jedini način
da se dva diska smeste u A1200 je da se izbaci flopi :)
    Idealno  rešenje  bi  bilo uzeti mini tower kućište od PC-ja. Em ste
rešili  problem  smeštaja,  kako  hard  diska, tako i budućih proširenja
(npr.  CD ROMa - interni modeli su mnogo jeftiniji od eksternih!), em je
za  duže vreme rešen problem napajanja - 200-250W će sasvim sigurno biti
više  nego  dovoljno  za  sve  moguće  potrebe - možete čak i monitor da
napajate preko njega :)
    Kome  je  100  DEM za mini tower kućište mnogo, može da potraži neko
jeftinije  rešenje  - ili da kupi polovno napajanje od nekog PC-ja, ili,
što  je takođe dobra varijanta, da uzme napajanje od video pokera! Takva
napajanja  su  više  nego dobro rešenje - imaju sve potrebne napone koje
kompjuter  i  periferije  zahtevaju,  a  ima  i  sasvim dovoljno snage -
60-80W,  što  je  takođe  više  nego  dovoljno.  I  u  jednoj i u drugoj
varijanti cena je 50-70 DEM.
    Jedini  problem  je  što je onda potrebno obezbediti kućište za hard
disk.  Naime,  nije  zgodno  da  hard  disk  stoji  tek tako na stolu, a
pogotovu  ga  nije preporučljivo pomerati dok radi. Rešenje je ili da se
napravi  kućište za njega (od neke plastike, drveta, betona ;) ), ili da
se  kupi  u inostranstvu, što je vrlo neisplativo (košta gotovo kao mini
tower kod nas).

    U sledećem nastavku: SCSI diskovi i gotova rešenja :)

                    Amiga system routine


   Amiga system test is a complicated set of routines which it must go
through before you can do any work on it. During the system test the Amiga
is attempting to let you know if the system is well. Here is a list of the
start-up activities:

 1. Clear all chips of old data
 2. Disable DMA and interrupts during the test.
 3. Clear the screen.
 4. Check the hardware ....checks to see if 68000 is functioning.
 5. Change screen color.
 6. Do a checksum test on all ROMS.
 7. Change screen color.
 8. Beginning of system startup.
 9. Check RAM at $C0000,and move SYSBASE there
10. Test All CHIP RAM.
11. Change screen color.
12. Check that software is coming in ok.
13. Change screen color.
14. Setup CHIP RAM to receive data.
15. Link the libraries
16. Check for additional memory and link it
17. Turn the DMA and interrupts back on.
18. Start a default task.
19. Check for 68010,68020, and or 68881.
20. Check to see if thee is an exception ...processor error
21. If so do a system reset.

   During this system test the Amiga is sending vital information to the
screen with colors. If the system checks out ok, you will see the following
sequence that you have seen so many times.

DARK GRAY:  The initial hardware tested OK. the 68000 is running
            and the registers are readable.

LIGHT GRAY: The software is coming in and seems OK.

WHITE:      The initialization test have passed.


   If something is wrong with your system, you may see the following:

RED:    Error was found in ROMS.

GREEN:  Error found in the CHIP RAM.

BLUE:   Error was found in the custom chips.

YELLOW: If 68000 found an error before the error trapping software (GURU)
        was running.


   The Keyboard has it's own processor, RAM and ROM. A selftest is performed
on power-up in the following sequence.

1. Performs checksum on ROM's
2. Checks 64 bytes of RAM.
3. The timer is tested.
4. Performs handshake with computer and gives results of selftest.

   If the keyboard does not pass the test it will notify you that it is not
working properly. This information is indicated with the blinking of the
CAPS-LOCK light.

One Blink:    Keyboard ROM check failed.

Two Blinks:   Keyboard RAM checked failed.

Three Blinks: Watch dog timer failed

Four Blinks:  A short between two row lines or special control
              keys.

       Na većini monitora se _ne mogu_ dobiti sve rezolucije. Za to će ti

je A1200 trenutno priključena na IBM-ov VGA monitor. Potpuno nova pesma u
odnosu na C1084 - DoublePal rezolucija (640x512, tj. 676x550 sa overscanom),
bez ikakvog treperenja :) Jedini problem je što je monitor 13", tako da je
sve prilično sitno, a i slika ne ide baš od ivice do ivice ekrana (ima jedan
prst bordera sa leve strane). Međutim, monitor je malo stariji (7-8 godina),
pa nije ni čudo što je tako :)
       Najveći problem je što ne prikazuje Amigine rezolucije, ali to se
rešava tako što se preko compozitnog izlaza Amiga poveže na video, pa na TV,
ili direktno na TV preko modulatora. Međutim, čak se i na VGA monitoru može
videti slika u toj rezoluciji (PAL/NTSC), ali to je dovoljno samo za nevolju
(npr. kod Early Boot Setup-a).

PRODUCT NAME

        HyperCOM1

BRIEF DESCRIPTION

        This is a internal high-speed serial port for the A1200, giving
you up to 460000 bps without high CPU load.


AUTHOR/COMPANY INFORMATION

        Name:           VMC Harald Frank
        Address:        Spargelstr. 8
                        68809 Neulu=DFheim
                        GERMANY

        Telephone:      ++49-6205-392065
        FAX:            ++49-6205-392067

        E-mail:         I don't know, but he used H.FRANK@tfh.dssd.sub.org
                        some time ago.


LIST PRICE

        DM 99 (~=3DUS$ 66)


MACHINE USED FOR TESTING

        Old C=3D-A1200, Blizzard IV (`030-50), SCSI-Kit, 24MB Fast
RAM, Kickstart and Workbench 3.1.  Modem used was a US Robotics Courier
V.34+.


INSTALLATION

        This is something special.  It doesn't plug into PCMCIA or the
normal expansion slot!  There is a small connector left inside the
A1200 where it's plugged in.  The serial connector is put in the
trapdoor under the floppy.

        Some notes to this connector: According to the manufacturer,
this was intentionally for plugging the 2nd meg of CHIP RAM in the
A1200, as it should have shipped with only 1MB CHIP.  Probably more
known is a battery clock by a 3th-party-company which was put in here.


REVIEW

        The package came with a two-page "manual" that described
briefly how to install it, a disk with the serial device, and a
registration card, and - of course - the hardware itself.  It's a tiny
2*4cm board with a 64(!) byte FIFO and some other stuff on it.

        Installation was really easy: just open the A1200 and plug it
into that connector.  As my trapdoor is already used by my SCSI, I
made a small slot into my A1200's case. So much for the hardware side.
Software was even more easy: just copy a HyperCOM1.device to DEVS: and
use it in the terminal program.  For those who need it, an
Installer script is provided.  :^)

        Until now I used my internal serial port with my 33,6kbps
modem, so I was used to the general slowdown while sending/receiving
something.  Now it's really cool!  115200 bps, downloading a text file
with 5492 cps, and the HyperCOM device just eats 2.14% CPU time!
(measured by Top/Executive package, downloading /dev/zero %-).
Haven't tested the 460000bps mode though, as I don't have anything
which could deal with such a high speed.  While using a normal
PPP connection, it ate around 1.42% CPU.  Just one drawback here:
ppp.device doesn't work with 115200 bps, but this seems to be a bug in
my ppp.device, as everything else works fine with it.

        For those who need it, there is a HyperCOM 3 (2 serial, one
parallel) and a HyperCOM 4 (4 serial, one parallel, but as a Z2 card)
available.

        As I ordered the thing I was asked by Mr Frank whether I want
some pictures of the cards. I said yes and he called me and sent 6
pics of the HyperCOM's.  On the evening I got the card he rung me up
again and asked if I'm happy with the card and whether everything is
OK.  Now that is what I call service. :)

        If anyone wants these, just contact me, but Mr Frank told me
he'll put up on a web server soon, so you'll probably find them there,
soon.

        One word to the phone service: Every time I called, Mr Frank
himself was on the phone, and as he's himself the developer he could
answer all the question I asked him.  Nothing to add.


DOCUMENTATION

        2 copied pages: one for disclaimer, another for installing the
thing (German only).

        I myself had been happy if there had been some technical
specs, something about the software...

        The installation guide itself is pretty easy to follow,
shouldn't be a problem.


LIKES

        - CHEAP! Even compared to similar PC products!
        - Easy to install and to use
        - Doesn't need either PCMCIA or the expansion port
        - The fastest serial for the Amiga I know about
        - Doesn't  eat  CPU  while  transferring (thanks to the 64 byte
buffer,
        the original serial had just 1!)
        - Good hotline!


DISLIKES AND SUGGESTIONS

        - Poor manual, although it covers the hardware installation
        quite good

        - If you have problems while uploading with NComm and any device
        other than serial.device: It's a problem of your
        xprzmodem.library, try another one.


COMPARISON TO OTHER SIMILAR PRODUCTS

        There isn't any real competition, as far as I see.  Only the
Surf Squirrel, but this is mainly a SCSI host adaptor, and the serial
only goes up to 115200 and is much more expensive.

        The only other card I know of which could come up to the specs
of this one was the GVP IO Extender, which goes up to 230000bps, but
was much more expensive (and is for Zorro Amigas only).


WARRANTY

        There is a registration card.  Don't know anything about
warranty, but as a matter of law (in my country) it has to be at least
6 months.


CONCLUSIONS

        This product is perfect for all who want to get rid of the bad
internal serial, especially owners of the A1200.  It's not very
expensive and gives you a very fast additional serial port.  So I can
recommend it to everybody who uses a modem.

        The larger HyperCOM's are probably quite interesting for
Sysops, as there is a Zorro version.

Jeste, fast memoriji može da pristupa samo cpu, a chip memoriji i custom
čipovi i cpu. Fast memorija je brža oko 25% (mada su za današnje pojmove i
jedna i druga spore). 512K memorije koju imaš na proširenju nije fast već
tzv. SlowFast memorija (počinje od adrese $C00000). Prava fast memorija
počinje od $200000 i dodaje se na edge konektor sa leve strane ili u hard
disk kontroler. SlowFast memorija je jednako brza (spora) kao i chip,
pošto pristup njoj ide preko Agnusa. Ako imaš Fat Agnus vrlo lako možeš
tih dodatnih 512K pretvoriti u chip ram, pa onda lepo imaš 1M chip ram-a.

 Km> kartici. Na ploči imam još mesta za pola MB, da li tu mogu zalemiti još
 Km> chipova?

Ne. Ta mesta služe za dodavanje 512K chip ram-a, ali samo ako ne postoji
proširenje na kartici (bilo koje - SlowFast ili Chip).

Ne bih ti znao reći, u Touring Car Racingu nisam daleko dogurao,
praktično sam ga samo pogledao. Ali, s obzirom na činjenicu da je gotovo
sigurno da postoji samo jedan izvor igre, mala je šansa da se moja kopija
i u čemu razlikuje od tvoje.

>> Kako idealno podesiti auto za malu kisicu ?

Na podešavanje spojlera mala kiša nema mnogo uticaja u igri. U
stvarnosti, oni se spuštaju, zato što slabi sila prianjanja bolida
na podlogu ('downforce'). Kako ovdje nemaš veliki izbor, ili ih ostavi
onakve kakve bi koristio na suhoj podlozi ili ih eventualno spusti za
jedan stepen. Inače, visinu spojlera u najvećoj mjeri diktira
konfiguracija staze.

Za različite podloge mnogo je važniji pravilan izbor guma. U slučaju
manje kiše, najbolje su one sa oznakom 'INT' (intermediate).

U globalu, najbolje podešen bolid je onaj koji ima najbolji 'grip'.
Uticaj visine spojlera na 'grip' je konstantan tokom cijele trke, dok se
gume troše. Veća vrijednost 'grip-a' se postiže izborom mekših guma, ali
je njihovo trošenje brže.

>> Da li uspevas da u prvoj sezoni napravis neki bolji rezultat ?

shrinking circle, and then drive off on the bridge.

TITLE
        ArmyMiner

VERSION
        1.4

AUTHOR

        Alain Laferriere
        laferrie@iro.umontreal.ca

DESCRIPTION

    ArmyMiner is a logic board game where some of the squares do contain
bombs. When clicked, the bomb-free squares display the number of bombs in
their neighbourhood. The objective of the game is for the user to mark all
the squares having bombs in a minimum of time. The game requires good
concentration and offers a very interesting mental challenge.

    There are many instances of that game on different platforms
(Minesweeper on IBM-compatible, XMines on XWindows, etc). ArmyMiner does
integrate all of the good aspects I've seen on all the versions of that game
available on personal computers.

FEATURES

  In addition to the conventional XMines-type features, it has:

  - Automatically mark or clean the neighbours of a square
  - Safe start (no explosion at first click)
  - Safe click (gadget-like behavior for squares)
  - Question marks (for configuration analysis)
  - A PAUSE option
  - An UNDO option that lets you restart a game after an explosion

  You can also specify your own custom board settings. The game has sound
effects, high-score tables and a very nice interface. It works on either
OS v1.3 or 2.0, under NTSC or PAL.

Hellfire je još jednom pokazao da nema konkurencije kad je u pitanju
"izdavanje" komercijalnih naslova. Ovog puta izbacili su CD rip dugo
očekivane avanture pod nazivom The Big Red Adventure, firme Core Design,
koju su zapravo napravili programeri Dynabyte-a, a koju prodaje Power
Computing po cijeni od 19.99 funti. Da, u pravu ste, radi se o istoj
igri kakva postoji na PC-u, i prema njihovim riječima, verzija za Amigu
je PUTPUNO identična, što znači - kompletan govor, grafika, animacija...!

Od hardvera ne traži ništa više od standardne Amige 1200 sa 2 MB memorije
i hard diskom. Dolazi u 6 LZX arhiva ukupne dužine 16 megabajta, dok
instalirana zauzme oko 24.

Ne znam koliko ste u toku, ali nedavno je zvanično izašao source kod
Linux verzije jedne od najpopularnijih igara svih vremena - Dooma!
Nekoliko Amigista se odmah bacilo na posao, pa smo u roku od dva dana
dobili nekoliko portova.

Ja sam isprobao tri. Prvi je izašao u obe verzije, sa i bez koprocesora,
i traži ixemul i ixnet biblioteke, a ako želite da ga igrate na custom
ekranu, i instaliran kompletan RTGMaster paket. U trenutku dok ovo pišem,
nije mi pošlo za rukom da ga pokrenem.

Drugi je manje zahtjevan, u principu traži samo 8 MB memorije i minimum
68020, ali kad se igra startuje ekran je zabrljan i ne može uspješno da
se igra.

Treći - i treća sreća! :) Radi kako treba, a početni zatjevi su mu slični
kao i kod prethodne verzije. Ne traži nikakve posebne biblioteke ni
koprocesor, a isto tako ni instalaciju dodatnih grafičkih drajvera, već
samo AGA čip set, 68020 i najmanje 8 MB memorije. Upravo ova verzija je i
zakačena uz poruku.

Pored svega navedenog, potrebno je naravno imati i bar jedan WAD fajl iz
neke verzije igre. Autori ne tvrde da njihove verzije rade sa svima, jer
ih ni sami nisu testirali. Ja sam nabavio onaj iz Linux shareware
varijante, i s njim nisam imao problema. Nisam provjeravao, ali vjerujem
da se WAD fajlovi za SW verzije Dooma mogu naći i ovdje u Sezamovim
direktorijumima ili konferencijama.

Ostale tekuće karakteristike svih portova su da još uvijek nemaju podršku
za zvuk ni za igranje u mreži, da neke opcije u samoj igri još nisu
realizovane i da nisu optimizovani za Motoroline procesore. Ali autori
sve to najavljuju u narednim verzijama, na koje, s obzirom na intenzitet
razvoja programa, sasvim sigurno nećemo dugo čekati.

U svakom slučaju, nemojte se razočarati ako igra bude spora na vašim

Doom, Ultimate Doom, Doom 2, Final Doom... sve savršeno glatko i to na
full screenu. :) Eh, ta Amiga je čudo... ;)

Neću odgovarati na svaku poruku posebno, već ću ovako u jednoj napraviti
malo detaljniji osvrt na groznicu koja je za novogodišnje praznike
zahvatila i Amiga populaciju... ;)


Stvari su kulminirale i brže nego što sam najavio u svojoj prethodnoj
poruci napisanoj ovde. Osim ona prva četiri porta, nedavno su se
pojavila još dva. Prvi PsiDoom, ne donosi ništa revolucionarno, dok se
drugi, DoomAttack, već nametnuo kao potencijalni šampion u brzini, makar
samo na srednjoj klasi Amiga. Oba još uvijek nisu dorađena i imaju
bagova.

AmiDoom i Amiga Doom su napredovali uglavnom u smislu podrške za razne
grafičke modove, zvuk i mrežu, i može se reći da su postali prilično
stabilni i upotrebljivi. Njihov osnovni nedostatak je bila i ostala
potreba za bibliotekama za emulaciju, što ih čini više i memorijski i
procesorski zahtjevnim. Port pod jednostavnim imenom Doom, bar koliko ja
znam, nije se više razvijao.

Daleko najkvalitetnija i verzija koja je najviše napredovala je ADoom.
Ima praktično sve, i što je najvažnije, optimizovan je i za najjače
procesore. Naime, svi ostali portovi ponašaju se potpuno isto, ako ne i
gore, na procesorima bržim od 68030. Ono što ja mogu da vam kažem iz
prve ruke je da kod mene na mojoj novoj mašini (za više informacija
pogledati sliku prikačenu uz poruku :) radi savršeno glatko u 'high
details' modu na čitavom ekranu! Na slabijim mašinama je takođe vrlo
igriv, ali na manjem ekranu ili sa manje detalja. Nisam zaista u stanju
da procijenim koliki je broj frejmova u sekundi, jer mi nijedna igra do
sada nije išla toliko glatko. :) Mogu samo da kažem da je i te kako
dovoljan. ;)

ADoom je ujedno i jedini port za sada koji podržava uvodnu muziku i
muziku u igri. U arhivi se nalazi i čitava banka MIDI semplova pomoću
kojih se to ostvaruje, mada moram reći da postoje dva dobra razloga zašto
je bolje da muziku ostavite po defaultu isključenu. Prvi, zato što
dodatno usporava igru, a drugi, zato što su semplovi vrlo lošeg
kvaliteta.

Inače, svi portovi sada podržavaju zvučne efekte u igri i igranje preko
tastature. Džojstikom ne možete da upravljate jedino u AmiDoomu i
PsiDoomu, a mišem u AmigaDoomu i PsiDoomu. ECS grafičke modove i modove
grafičkih kartica ne možete da koristite takođe u PsiDoomu, kao ni u
DoomAttacku. Te dvije verzije za sada ne podržavaju ni igru preko TCP/IP
mreže.

Što se tiče igranja u mreži, to još nisam imao prilike da probam. Ali
sudeći po reakcijama ljudi koji jesu, radi sasvim fino, i u lokalnih
mrežama povezanim ethernet karticama i preko Interneta, korištenjem ili
Miamia ili AmiTCP-a. Eventualno je potrebno da se isključe neke opcije u
igri ako su provajderi udaljeni da bi se dobile maksimalne performanse.

A sada malo o verzijama WAD fajlova, koristeći ADoom kao referencu...

Kratko i jasno: rade sve registrovane/komercijalne verzije WAD-ova!

U početku sam bio malo zbunjen načinom na koji ih program prepoznaje,
ali sam uz malo isprobavanja kasnije uglavnom shvatio kako to sve
funkcioniše.

Naime, jako je važno kako se WAD fajl zove. Za shareware verziju koju sam
ovde poslao rezervisano je ime DOOM1.WAD. Ako bilo koji drugi WAD
nazovete tim imenom, nećete dobiti ništa više od one jedne demo epizode.

Ultimate Doom WAD fajl (12,408,320 bajtova) možete da nazovete DOOM.WAD
ili DOOM2.WAD, ali tada će vam pri izboru biti ponuđene samo prve tri
epizode. Ako ga preimenujete u DOOMU.WAD, na raspolaganju će vam biti i
četvrta.

Doom 2 WAD fajl (14,604,584) bi trebao originalno da se zove DOOM2.WAD.
Kod njega nema izbora epizoda, svi nivoi su u okviru jedne i igraju se
isključivo sekvencijalno.

Final Doom: Evilution (18,195,736) treba da se zove TNT.WAD. Ako u istom
direktorijumu ne budete imali nešto što se zove DOOM1.WAD ili DOOM2.WAD,
program će ga automatski prepoznati i učitati.

Final Doom: The Plutonia Experiment (18,240,172) treba da se zove
PLUTONIA.WAD. Za njega isto važi kao i za Evilution.

Na više mjesta sam pročitao da zbog svoje kompleksnosti epizode Final
Dooma rade sporije. Probao sam i došao do zaključka da kod mene nema
nikakvog usporenja. ;)

To su bile sve komercijalne verzije Dooma za koje ja znam. Ako postoji
još neka, neka me kolege PC-jevci isprave.

Uglavnom, nemojte da vas zbuni opis -file opcije. Ona ne služi za
učitavanje gore navedenih verzija WAD fajlova, jer se oni kao što sam
rekao moraju automatski prepoznati od strane glavnog programa, već za
učitavanje korisničkih WAD-ova. Da biste iskoristili neki od njih, osim
što ćete njegovo ime navesti kao argument uz opciju -file, potrebno je da
u direktorijumu imate i neku od registrovanih/komercijalnih verzija.

Neki od tih 'custom' WAD-ova mijenjaju samo oružja, neprijatelje ili
teksture u igri, dok drugi u sebi imaju definisane kompletne nove nivoe.
U svakom slučaju, na Internetu ih možete naći na hiljade.

dok oni "gore" ne naprave nešto konkretno, svi naši napori i diskusije će
ostati na - pokušajima.

Programski segmenti

Program, napisan za Amigu, mozemo podeliti na 3 dela: kod, podaci i BBS
segment. A kodnom segmentu su komande, tj. ceo program. U segmentu podataka
(data segment) su predefinisani vrednosti programa. Ovi podaci su cesto
direktno u kodnom segmentu; u ovom slucaju nema potrebe za data segment. To ne
stvara nikakve probleme. Ali, ako stavimo i kodni i data segment u program,
onda to ima prednosti, naime tada program (koju smo startovali) stavi kodni i
data segment na razlicite memorijske lokacije (zavisno od toga gde je i koliko
mesta zauzima). Ako imamo samo jedan kodni segment, onda ne bi smo imali
dovoljno uvek slobodne memorije i nastala bi problema kod ucitanja. Treci je
BBS segment. To definise jednu povrsinu, kod koje pocetna faza ,tj. sadrzaj,
nije vazna. Kad ucitamo program, on uzima jedno deo iz memorije, toliko veliko,
koliko je u BSS segmentu definisano (hunk_bss, pogledaj kasnije).

Evo, moderator NET.AMIGA će pokušati da ti neka objašnjenja... :)

SETNet konferencije (samim tim i NET.AMIGA) se prate isključivo preko
BBS-ova povezanih u tu mrežu. Njih ima dosta, kako u Beogradu, tako i u
ostalim krajevima Srbije. Umreženo je i nekoliko BBS-ova iz Makedonije,
a postoji težnja da se povežu i sistemi iz susjednih zemalja, pa čak i
iz ostalih bivših YU republika.

O organizaciji se brine grupa entuzijasta, mreža za sada nije komercijalna,
što znači da je pristup potpuno besplatan. Dovoljno je da pozoveš jedan
od BBS-ova u mreži (u pravilu, onaj koji ti je najbliži ili koji najlakše
dobijaš), da se standardno prijaviš i čim te sysop registruje, postao si
član SETNet-a! Princip praćenja je potpuno isti kao i u svim lokalnim
konferencijama kakve si sigurno imao prilike da vidiš po raznim BBS-ovima.
Najpogodniji način za učestovanje u konferencijama je standardno
sakupljanje poruka u QWK ili Blue Wave formatu, čitanje i odgovaranje u
odgovarajućim readerima i slanje paketa sa odgovorima. Konferencije koje
se razmjenjuju u mreži prepoznaćeš po prefiksu NET. u imenu. Inače,
razmjena se obavlja jednom dnevno, u ranim jutarnjim satima.

Osim konferencija, možeš da šalješ i privatne poruke putem tzv.
NET.MAIL-a. Tu je važno da osim korisničkog imena znaš i adresu korisnika
kojem šalješ poruku, jer se za razliku od konferencija koje se prenose na
sve sisteme u mreži, mail prenosi samo na onaj čiju si adresu naveo.
Adrese, imena i brojeve telefona BBS-ova u mreži trebalo bi da možeš naći
na svakom umreženom sistemu. Neke od tih podataka možeš naći i u
Sezamovoj YUBBS listi.

Od skora se SETNet konferencije razmjenjuju i sa Beointernet-om. One se
tamo nalaze u obliku tzv. news grupa, a organizacija je ista kao i na
velikom Internetu. Prenosi se i mail, ali da bi dobio svoju Beointernet
e-mail adresu na SETNet-u, moraš tražiti posebno odobrenje. Beointernet-u
možeš pristupiti ako imaš nalog na nekom od računara ETF-a, FON-a ili
raznih drugih institucija koje su povezane u tu mrežu. Kako dobiti račun
i kako koristiti dotični sistem posebna je priča za svaki od njih i u to
ne bih ulazio.

Sa Sezama se, bar što se tiče konferencije posvećene Amigi, za sada ne
možeš uključiti u SETNet. Teme koje Sezam razmjenjuje sa SETNet-om (preko
Beointernet-a) su strogo ograničene i za sada se svode samo na male
oglase, neke teme vezane za programiranje i komunikacije i teme posvećene
YUCCA i CADUA.

Što se tiče same NET.AMIGA, vidjećeš i sam, konferencija slična ovoj na
Sezamu. Različiti ljudi, različiti profili, različita interesovanja, ali
ih sve zajedno veže jedna stvar - Amiga. :)


Ako te još nešto zanima, slobodno pitaj. Detalje o organizaciji SETNet-a
i pravilnik možeš naći u obliku fajlova u direktorijumima BBS-ova koji su
u mreži.

included.

browser  (za  Amigu  -  npr.  Amiga  Mosaic;  on, kao i skoro svi ostali

    Dakle:  instalirate  MUI  (verzija  2.3  bi  morala  da postoji i na
Sezamu,  osim  ako  nije  ostala u staroj konf. :( ), zatim Amiga Mosaic
(ili  neki  drugi browser). Instalirate i sve što se iz MLinka odnosi na
Amigu,   pozovete   mašinu  na  kojoj  imate  nalog  (mora  biti  Unix),
uploadujete  fajl  mlink.tar.gz  (otkucate  'rz  mlink.tar.gz',  a zatim
startujete ZModem upload) i raspakujete ga ('gzip -d mlink.tar.gz', 'tar
-xvf mlink.tar').
    Trebalo  bi  da  dobijete direktorijum mlink. U njemu se nalazi sors
ovog programa. Potrebno je kompajlirati ga ('cd mlink'; 'sh buildmlink')
i  ako  sve prođe kako treba, dobićete program mlink (Upozorenje: nikako
mi nije uspelo da ga iskompajliram od SCO Unixom, tj. na mašini fon.fon;
na  osmehu  -  SunOS  i  galebu  -  Linux je prošlo bez problema). Njega
iskopirate  u svoj home direktorijum ('cp mlink ~/', ako se ne varam), a
zatim  sve ostalo pobrišete ('rm *'). Vratite se u svoj home dir ('cd'),
a onda konfigurišete sve što treba preko tooltype-ova u ikoni MLinka (na
Amigi,  naravno).  U  uputstvu od MLinka je prilično lepo objašnjeno šta
čemu  služi,  ali  ono  osnovno  (što  je  kod mene podešeno, i radi bez
problema):  stavite  tooltype-ove HISPEED, BAUD=57600 (ili na koliko već
terate serial.device), CPS=1500 (nije naročito bitno), CTSRTS, i (važno)
UNIXSTARTUP="~/mlink".
    Kad  ste  sve  ovo  sredili, startujete mlink (pod uslovom da ste na
vezi!)  i  kad  dobijete  poruku  da  je  mlink konekcija uspostavljena,
startujete  Mosaic.  Tu  kliknete na 'Open', unesete adresu (URL) site-a
ili  home  page-a  koji  želite  da  pogledate,  i  vozite :) Od domaćih
site-ova  probajte  www.etf.bg.ac.yu, ili www.fon.bg.ac.yu. Od stranih -
paaa,  imate  samo oko sedam miliona Web stranica na raspolaganju :)) Za
početak,  probajte  www.yahoo.com,  koji  daje  pregled najzanimljivijih
site-ova,  pa  još  razvrstan  po  kategorijama...  Trenutno  su kod nas
naročito  popularni  www.playboy.com  i www.nba.com :) U onom Amiga Main
Internet  List-u  bi  trebalo  da imate i neke zanimljive Amiga site-ove
(home page Amiga Tech.-a je na www.amiga.de).
    Za  sada toliko, kukajte ako bude probleme (a moguće da će ih biti -
ovo  sve  pišem  'iz  glave',  Osmeh je nemoguće dobiti), i - srećno vam

MultiLink v1.34 - by Ezra Story
                    ===============================

    Multilink (or Mlink) is a package which simulates a direct
connection to the internet.  If you have an account on a UNIX machine
connected to the internet, you can run Multilink on the UNIX machine and
your Amiga, and Multilink will allow you to use all those wonderful
Amiga networking applications such as Grapevine, DaFTP, telnet and
Amosaic without having to have a real SLIP or PPP connection.  Multilink
emulates both AS225 and Amitcp, so you do not need to run either of these
protocol stacks to use multilink.

    Multilink requires at least AmigaDOS 2.1 and an account on a UNIX
host connected to the Internet.

DESCRIPTION

    -- Script to download HTML systems across the network --

    GetURL.rexx is an ARexx script which will download World-Wide Web pages.
    With a simple command line it will download a specific page, and with
    more complex command lines it will be able to download specific sets of
    documents.

    The intention was to create a tool that allowed local caching of important
    web pages and a flexible way of specifying what pages are important. The
    script has no GUI as of yet but may have at some stage in the future.

    If you have ever tried to download and save to disc a 200 page document
    using Mosaic, then you know what this script is for. Mosaic will only
    let you load a page, then load it to disc, then load another page etc.
    This is a very frustrating process. GetURL automates this process and
    will run in batch mode without user intervention.

    The major features of GetURL.rexx are as follows:

    * doesn't require AMosaic, so you can be browsing something else
        with AMosaic whilst this is running

    * save pages to your hard disc so that they can be read offline and
        you can also give them to friends on a floppy disc. Who knows,
        you may even be able to sell discs containing web pages :-)

    * flexible set of command line switches that allow you to restrict the
        type of pages that it downloads

    * ability to specify files for the lists of URLs that it keeps so
        that any search for pages can be stopped and restarted at a later
        date. i.e. you could run GetURL for 2 hours a day whilst you are
        online and gradually download everything in the entire universe
        and it won't repeat itself.

    * includes the ability to download itself when there are new versions.

    * will use a proxy if you have access to one, in order to both speed up
        access to pages and also to reduce network load.

    * will download binary files (*.gif, *.lha) as easily as text and html
        files.

NEW FEATURES

    * AmigaDOS pattern matching to specify or restict URLs to download

    * a few bugs fixed

    * documentation

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

    * Until somebody writes a TCP: device for the AS225 TCP/IP protocol

-=-=-=-=-=- Introduction -=-=-=-=-=-

IPDial is a program to establish a SLIP, CSLIP or PPP connection to an ISP
(Internet service provider). This is done using a script file which consists
of commands like "SEND ATZ" or "WAIT CONNECT". After the connection is
established, IPDial usually logs in with your user account and activates
CLIP/PPP on the remote machine. When all this is successfully done, IPDial
exits and lets SLIP/PPP take over the modem connection.

When you want to disconnect, you can also use IPDial to make to modem
physically hang up the line after SLIP/PPP has terminated.

Furthermore, IPDial has a built-in terminal mode which uses the current
shell window. If something fails while it is trying to establish a
connection you can just press Ctrl-F to enter the terminal mode and log in
manually.



-=-=-=-=-=- Features -=-=-=-=-=-

- built-in shell terminal mode: You can always interrupt your dial script
  if something went wrong or enter a secret password without permanently
  writing it into your script file.

- IPDial can read the serial configuration (device, unit, baud rate and
  handshake protocol) from a SANA configuration file. If you ever want to
  use a different baud rate, just change it for your SANA device, IPDial
  will automatically use your new settings.

- own script language: Simple but powerful BASIC-like script language. See
  included script files for examples.

- very small: IPDial is only about 26KB small and uses very little memory
  while running. No space is wasted for a never needed GUI.

- sample scripts included: Just adapt of of the example scripts to your
  Internet provider. You don't have to write your own programs!

- Public Domain: IPDial is absolutely free with full source code included.

   BOOPSI classes are partially custom designed for AWeb, and partially
   from the ClassAct kit.

 o AWeb can use AmiTCP/IP, I-Net225 or AS-225 as its TCP stack. Without
   TCP stack running, you can still view local files.

 o AWeb uses extensive internal multitasking, which leads to total
   asynchroneous and parallel network access. Images are starting to load
   while the document is still loading. It is possible to follow a link
   while the previous document is still loading. A separate network status
   window shows all pending network and local file accesses. All network
   accesses can be interrupted immediately.

 o The HTML-2 standard is fully supported, including forms. For buggy
   pages not conforming to the standard, AWeb offers a compatibility mode.

 o AWeb supports the use of proxies for HTTP, FTP, Gopher and Telnet.
   Because some proxies can't handle forms or other special cases, the use
   of proxies can be temporarily disabled from the menu.

 o The HTTP and Gopher protocols are supported internally. By using
   external programs, FTP and Mailto can be used too. HTTP user
   authorization is supported.

 o AWeb lets you load all images, delay all image loading, or load only
   clickable maps and delay other images. For delayed images, the ALT text
   is taken into account. Transparent GIFs are supported. The 24-bit picture
   datatype (picturedtV43) is supported.

 o To improve network speed, host names and network addresses are cached
   so addresses are looked up only once during a session.

 o AWeb can open it's windows on the default public screen, on a named
   public screen or open its own screen.

 o In extension to its own hotlist, AWeb can read the hotlists of
   AMosaic and IBrowse.

 o An advanced settings requester is integrated in the program.

 o AWeb has an ARexx interface, and a unique and powerful shell command
   interface.



REQUIREMENTS
------------

AWeb needs:
 o OS 3.0 or better
 o At least 2MB of memory, preferably more
 o Either AmiTCP/IP, I-Net225 or AS-225 if you want to access the Internet
 o Appropriate picture datatypes (GIF, JPEG) to show inlined images



INSTALLATION
------------

To install AWeb, just double-click the Install icon.

If you want to try AWeb before a permanent installation, make sure to
double-click the "MakeAssign" icon first. It makes the necessary assigns
that AWeb needs to find the ClassAct classes.



DOCUMENTATION
-------------

The archive contains full documentation in HTML format. If you prefer a
printed copy, get the archive AWebdoc_ps.lha for the same documentation
in PostScript format.

     * Why this FAQ ?

       Unfortunately an alpha-version of Aweb, a new World Wide Web
       browser, has been heavily spread through Internet and several
       bulletin board systems. This resulted in a huge amount of Email
       from illegal users. This illegal use is strongly rejected. Since
       the author prefers spending his precious time on further
       developing AWeb instead of answering Email, this FAQ should answer
       the most common questions.

     * What is AWeb ?

       AWeb is a new World Wide Web browser for the Amiga computer. AWeb
       is completely designed and developed by Yvon Rozijn. The current
       version has among other things the following features :


          + Full HTML-2 support (including forms). (screenshot)

          + Total asynchroneous and parallel network access. It is even
            possible to follow a link while the previous document is
            still loading.

          + AmiTCP/IP as well as Inet225 support.

          + AWeb does not use MUI. It uses BOOPSI gadgets instead, which
            results in less memory usage and increased speed.

          + Parallel image loading.

          + A network status window. The network status window shows all
            pending network and local file accesses. There are
            possibilities to cancel selected transfers, or all transfers.

          + Gopher support.

          + Proxy support.

          + Caching of network host names and addresses.

          + 24-bit datatype (picturedt V43) support.

          + Without a TCP/IP stack running, you can still read local
            files.

          + Load all images, no images, or clickable maps only.

          + Opens in a window, on any public screen or on an own screen.

          + The ALT-text of non-loaded images is taken into account.

          + Immediate response to interrupt-requests.

          + AMosaic-hotlist handling.

          + ARexx port.

          + HTTP user authorization. Because AWeb is able to store
            user-id and password, it prevents you from typing your id and
            password over and over again.

          + FTP and mail support through external programs.

          + Advanced setting requesters. Currently the requesters allow
            the user to adjust or configure:
               o Fonts and styles AWeb uses for different types of text.
                 (screenshot)
               o Link colors and underlining.
               o Screensettings.
               o Screencolors for AWeb's own screen.
               o Location and size of the AWeb windows.
               o General network settings (image loading and home page).
               o Proxy settings.
               o External ftp and mail commands.
               o Save and temp paths.
               o External editor and HTML source viewer.
               o MIME types AWeb should recognize and the external
                 viewers to use.
          + new Anonymous browsing. Normally, if you follow a hyperlink,
            AWeb sends the address of the page that link appeared on to
            the server. This allows servers to generate lists of
            back-links for interest, logging, optimized caching, tracing
            obsolete or mistyped links etc. Because the source of a link
            may be private information, or may reveal an otherwise
            private information source, AWeb allows you to disable this
            feature.
          + new Execute shell commands. AWeb offers a unique and powerful
            facility to execute Amiga DOS Shell commands from a page,
            just by clicking on a hotlink or by submitting a form. With
            some effort, you can create complex applications using AWeb
            as the user interface, starting scripts that dynamically
            compose new documents that are loaded into AWeb via ARexx
            etc. Although this feature is very useful, it could also be
            very dangerous. Therefore this feature works only from local
            pages.


       All features mentioned here are actually implemented. This is not
       some kind of to-do-list.


     * What do I need to run AWeb ?

       Basically the only constraint is that you need to run OS3.x in
       order to take full advantage of AWeb, because AWeb makes use of
       datatypes.


     * new How fast is AWeb ? new

       AWeb is fast. Beta-testers report AWeb to be much faster than
       IBrowse in side by side tests. Loading the same page, with IBrowse
       starting first, AWeb loads and displays the page - and can go back
       - before IBrowse gets the page displayed. AWeb seems to be faster
       than ALynx, too.


     * Where can I get AWeb ?

       You can get a legal copy of the latest alpha version only if you
       are a subscriber to the bimonthly Dutch Amiga Magazine and have
       access to their BBS. All copies obtained in another way are
       illegal copies and probably outdated. Currently, the newest
       beta-release requires a personal keyfile.


     * Can I become a beta-tester ?

       No, currently there are enough beta-testers.


     * When will AWeb be available to the public ?

       Probably somewhere in March a registerable freeware version of
       AWeb will be put on Aminet. You do not have to pay to use it, but
       if you register you get a more advanced version. An announcement
       will be posted in comp.sys.amiga.networking and
       comp.sys.amiga.misc. Of course this page will provide all
       information regarding the release-version.


     * How about future versions of AWeb ?

       The freeware version will support HTML-2. Future versions will
       also support HTML-3 and will have a lot of advanced features, like
       client pull, server push and a disk-based document and image
       cache. These future versions will be shareware. The shareware-fee
       is yet unknown.


     * How do I contact the AWeb author ?

       At this stage Yvon Rozijn prefers to work on AWeb instead of
       answering huge amounts of Email. Legal users know how to contact
       him. For others it is not yet possible to get in contact.


     * Can I report suggestions to improve AWeb ?

       If you are using a legal copy, yes. Otherwise, not yet. If you are
       a legal user and have suggestions or comments regarding AWeb, you
       can Email them to aweb@dds.nl.


     * Can I report AWeb-bugs ?

       If you are using a legal copy, yes. Otherwise, not yet. If you are
       a legal user and want to report a problem, you can Email a problem
       description, along with information on your system-configuration
       to aweb@dds.nl.


     * I still have questions. What do I do ?

       Questions, comments and suggestions regarding this FAQ should be
       sent to Jeroen Oudejans.

It has the following differences from the AmiTCP beta4 version:

1) Mailto: is supported.

        Sendmail
        Editor

    which should be paths to the relevant programs. I've tested sendmail
    as the sendmail from AmigaUUCP 1.17b4 and SMTPpost from INetUtils 1.4.
    For an editor, I've used DME and C:ED.

    You may also specify

        Mosaic/Sendmail
        Mosaic/Editor
        Sendmail
        Editor

    as environment variables. They are checked in the above order. The
    environment variables override entries in Mosaic/prefs.

2) Move files from T:

   You may now move temporary files from T:.

   AMosaic uses two different types of temporary files (don't ask, you
   really don't want to know). For most files, set

        TempDir

   in your Mosaic/Prefs file to the desired directory.

   You may optionally set

        Mosaic/TempDir

   as an environment variable. If set, it overrides Mosaic/Prefs. It
   also must end in a '/' for a ':'.

   For other temporary files, set the environment variable

        HOME

   to another temporary directory. If Mosaic/Tempdir is not set, either
   in the environment or in the Mosaic/Prefs file, but HOME is, then
   both types of temporary files will go to the directory specified by
   the HOME variable.

   rlogin, or tn3270 sessions.

DESCRIPTION
    Smodem is a new generation file transfer protocol. Unlike older
    protocols, like Zmodem, it has a separate low level multiplexed
        transfer layer (MSLP) and a high level file transfer layer. This
        new design simplifies protocol design and will give a maximum
        efficiency of as high as 99,5%.

    Multiplexing has made it possible to send one or more files in one
    continuous stream without any breaks between files. This will boost
    multiple file transfers dramatically.

    Smodem allows you to have chat during filetransfer. Chat is done
    via string gadget and the whole "sentence" is sent at once. This
    allows easy implementation of multinode chats during file transfers
    and tranferrates don't decrease drascticly.

    The protocol has a symmetrical nature. You can connect Smodem with
    itself by looping transmitted characters back to the receiver.
    There is no reason to limit transfers in one direction. Smodem
    will transfer files in both directions at the same time without
    noticeable performance loss.

    SModem works also on telnet lines, if encapsulation is turned on.

se  nalazi  u  WB:net).  U njemu će biti kreiran direktorijum AmiTCP-4.2

fajlova, a onda najvažniji deo - konfiguracija.
    Pod  'Default  user name' unesete svoje korisničko ime (poželjno ono
koje  koristite  na  EUnetu). Zatim je potrebno uneti još neke podatke o
novom  korisniku  -  tj.  vama. To su: korisničko ime, User ID, Group ID
(ostavite  default), puno ime, home dir (meni je, npr. Data:home/mikis),
i  dodajte  podatke  u  bazu  (svi  podaci  o  korisnicima  su  u  fajlu

konfigurisanje protokola.
    Dakle, za pristup EUnet Yu, izaberemo "PPP configuration". Interfejs
je  ppp0,  adresa  je  dinamička,  netmask  - default. Podesimo paametre
serijskog  uređaja  -  device  koji koristimo (npr. serial.device), Unit
number  (0), Baud rate (57600 za 14400 modeme - sa 2400 modemom PPP nema
mnogo  smisla;  poželjno  da  vam ova vrednost bude kao u komunikacionom
programu),  MTU  (ostavite  kako je ponuđeno), i najzad, možete izabrati
Dial-script  koji će pozvati vašeg provajdera i automatski se ulogovati.
Kod mene taj script izgleda ovako:

;početak skripta
     ECHO ON
     TIMEOUT 3000
     REDIALDELAY 100
     REDIAL "BUSY"
     SEND "ATDP186444"
     WAIT "CONNECT"
     WAIT "ogin"
     SEND "guest"
     WAIT "ssword"
     SEND "ppp"
;kraj skripta

opcije  vezane  za  ppp0  interfejs (u principu, samo uključite Hardware
handshake /CTS/RTS/).

unesete   "EUnet.yu"   (bez  navodnika,  naravno  ;).  Inetd  ne  morate

    194.247.192.17

provided by AmiTCP4.3 (newsgroups c.s.a.networking, c.s.a.applications,

                Changes to original Start(Stop)net
                ----------------------------------

- start Server (i.e. inetd) by default, switch off by using NOSRV
- you can specify a provider config when starting up, default is set
  to the usual provider.conf.
- UMS starts the User-Startnet script for me i.e. it fetches news &
  mails and after that it logs off.
- starts httpproxy automatically (if UMS not specified)
- Stopnet with option HANG logs off automatically (you need to have
  IPDial installed for using this feature and a hangup script)
  (IPDial is avalaible on Aminet: comm/tcp/IPDial20.lha)

                Configuration (Startnet)
                ------------------------

You very probably have to remove the UMS switch from the script and
change the lines concerned by it:

Original

    If {UMS}
        If Exists AmiTCP:db/User-Startnet
          Execute AmiTCP:db/User-Startnet
        EndIf
    Else
        run amitcp:bin/httpproxy cache eh0:tmp del 5184000 expire 604800 log
eh0:uue/Spool/httpproxy.log get unread
    Endif

Change to

    If Exists AmiTCP:db/User-Startnet
      Execute AmiTCP:db/User-Startnet
    EndIf

                Provider.conf files
                -------------------

My provider.conf files serves as an example how to automatically dial up,
login and start the slirp program (I'm not yet using a real slip connection)
It has been much adopted to the computer I log into so you will have to
change it. The offline.conf can be used either to run AmiTCP offline or to
reconnect after a RESET has been done. Simply start with:
> startnet offline

Remember that the host name MUST be specified in db/hosts and the domain(s)
& Nameserver(s) MUST be specified in resolv.conf for the offline config.

                Devices
                -------

It seems that most devices have to be configured in db/autointerfaces. At
least I did not succeed with slip0 (which is defined in db/interfaces)
when not specified there. I got the following error:

Sana2 configuration file and contents NOT definedin interface configuration!
Could not open serial device for dialing!
Interface slip0 not found!
Interface configuration failed!
Stopping AmiTCP
Memory NOT flushed!

It worked fine when I changed aslip.device to rhslip.devide in autointerfaces
so at least you should find a possibility to use f.e. rhcslip.
But I had no problems using magplip device (only defined it in interfaces)
(though I have not tested if the link itself works).

                Final Words/Future
                ------------------

Please E-Mail me if you have any suggestions/improvements/problems/comments
with/to my scripts. I will try then to help you or to improve them.

If you ask me very friendly I might (re)write the Dial script so you can
provide several phone numbers for dialing (if one is busy..). I might need
this myself somewhen in the future. The basic idea is to use an array for
the phonenumber and to tell how much numbers we have (-> easy to configure).

                             ===============


INTRODUCTION
------------

AWeb is a World Wide Web browser for the Amiga computer.

It offers the following features:

 o AWeb doesn't use Magical User Interface (MUI). It uses BOOPSI classes
   instead, which results in less memory usage and increased speed. The
   BOOPSI classes are partially custom designed for AWeb, and partially
   from the ClassAct kit.

 o AWeb can use a wide range of TCP-stacks: AmiTCP/IP, I-Net225, AS-225
   or compatible. Without TCP stack running, you can still view local files.

 o AWeb uses extensive internal multitasking, which leads to total
   asynchroneous and parallel network access. Images are starting to load
   while the document is still loading. It is possible to follow a link
   while the previous document is still loading. A separate network status
   window shows all pending network and local file accesses. All network
   accesses can be interrupted immediately.

 o The HTML-2 standard is fully supported, including forms. For buggy
   pages not conforming to the standard, AWeb offers a compatibility mode.

 o AWeb supports the use of proxies for HTTP, FTP, Gopher and Telnet.
   Because some proxies can't handle forms or other special cases, the use
   of proxies can be temporarily disabled from the menu.

 o The HTTP and Gopher protocols are supported internally. By using
   external programs, FTP and Mailto can be used too. HTTP user
   authorization is supported.

 o AWeb lets you load all images, delay all image loading, or load only
   clickable maps and delay other images. For delayed images, the ALT text
   is taken into account. Transparent GIFs are supported. The 24-bit picture
   datatype (picturedtV43) is supported.

 o To improve network speed, host names and network addresses are cached
   so addresses are looked up only once during a session.

 o AWeb can open it's windows on the default public screen, on a named
   public screen or open its own screen.

 o In extension to its own hotlist, AWeb can read other hotlists, like
   those of AMosaic and early IBrowse betas.

 o An advanced settings requester is integrated in the program.

 o AWeb has an ARexx interface, and a unique and powerful shell command
   interface.



REQUIREMENTS
------------

AWeb needs:
 o OS 3.0 or better
 o At least 2MB of memory, preferably more
 o Either AmiTCP/IP, I-Net225 or AS-225 if you want to access the Internet
 o Appropriate picture datatypes (GIF, JPEG) to show inlined images



VERSION 1.1
-----------
AWeb 1.1 is a bugfix with many bugs fixed that were left in version 1.0.

Changes in this version include:
 o Fixed several bugs:
    + crashed on 68000 machines at some URLs like www.yahoo.com
    + sending forms with empty fields didn't work
    + loading MPEGs skipped 1 byte
    + crashed when typing beyond the border of a textarea form field
    + image memory cache limit didn't work
    + downloading image didn't save but started external viewer instead
    + shift-click on ftp link stopped AWeb
    + didn't adapt to different frame size for navigation buttons
    + GIFs didn't show up as transparent, or were messed up totally
    + some settings weren't saved correctly when changed
 o Transparent GIF now works even if the GIF datatype used doesn't
   support transparency

 - Introduction -

AmyBW  is  a  program  that  will  enable  you to read and write electronic
messages,  using  the "Blue Wave Mail System".  Blue Wave has become one of
the  most popular systems to read mail offline.  Unfortunately this is only
true for the PC users, it isn't very popular on other platforms...YET.

Now  you  can  use  AmyBW  on  your Amiga!  It is fully compatible with the
original  PC  version,  except it doesn't have every feature the PC version
has.    Some   features  were  intentionally  left  out,  others  might  be
implemented  in  the  future.   On  the  other  hand  AmyBW  has some extra
features,  such as a sample player to signal you on personal messages and a
line wrapping message quoter.

also  handle  QWK mail packets. Well, actually it just converts QWK packets
to BlueWave packets and replies the other way around. Consider it a  better
than nothing feature. :-)

run AmyBW:

BGUI for AWeb's Settings window!
                    =================================


Short:        Improving the speed of AWeb's settings window?
Author:       bornhall@karkis.canit.se (Peter Bornhall)
Uploader:     bornhall@karkis.canit.se (Peter Bornhall)
Type:         comm/tcp
Distribution: Freeware


This is just a mock-up of what the AWeb settings window might (should) look
like using the BGUI package.  This means that it requires BGUI.library to
reside in LIBS:.  BGUI 1.2 can be found on AmiNet, in dev/gui I believe.

So, why did I do this then?  Am I a hater of ClassAct?  No, that's not the
reason, as I think ClassAct is pretty good actually.  But, then came AWeb,
which had its settings use ClassAct.  And GOD DAMN it is slow!  I thought
BGUI was slow in redrawing on a screen with 128 colours, but ClassAct really
took the prize this time.  And the chooser at the top, that alone takes more
than a second to open up the first time.

And, on the whole, the cycle/chooser gadget is a pretty bad choice for
something you may need to swap back and forth several times (we ARE talking a
prefs program here, which you might use a lot when you start using a program).

That is why I sat down and put together a quick "AWeb Settings" look-alike with
BGUIBuilder.  Now, I'm all for BGUI, since it's only ONE SINGLE library, but I
know there are lots of people who think it is too slow.  But hey, ClassAct IS
slower, at least when I tried it here on my machine.  Without BGUI loaded, it
took about 4 seconds to load the BGUI look-alike, and without the different
ClassAct-parts loaded, the built-in version took some 5 seconds to appear.
Neither of these are very good times, but then the Amiga isn't top-of-line when
it comes to processing power anymore.

Anyway, the BGUI version uses tabs instead of a cycle/chooser gadget, making it
a hell of a lot easier to work with.  The only thing I wasn't able to really do
was the palette stuff in Screen/Palette.  But, I didn't want to put too much
work into it, since this is probably where my idea will end.

However, if you feel like me, write to Yvon Rozjin at yrozijn@xs4all.nl and
tell him what you think.

At least he could make the windows use the bottom border for the sizing gadget
instead of the horrible left border that is present in AWeb 1.1.

Thank you and goodbye.

-=-=-=-=-=- Introduction -=-=-=-=-=-

IPDial is used to establish a SLIP, CSLIP or PPP connection to an ISP
(Internet service provider). This is done using a script file which consists
of commands like SEND "ATZ" or WAIT "CONNECT". After the connection is
established, IPDial usually logs in with your user account and activates
SLIP/PPP on the remote machine. When all this is successfully done, IPDial
exits and your SLIP/PPP device takes over the line.

When you want to disconnect, you can also use IPDial to make to modem
physically hang up the line after SLIP/PPP has terminated.

Furthermore, IPDial has a built-in terminal mode which uses the current
shell window. If something fails while IPDial is trying to establish a
connection, you can just press Ctrl-F to enter the terminal mode and log in
manually.



-=-=-=-=-=- Features -=-=-=-=-=-

IPDial has several features that many other dialers lack:

- built-in shell terminal mode: You can always interrupt your dial script
  if something went wrong or enter a secret password without writing it into
  your dial script file.

- IPDial can read the serial configuration (device, unit, baud rate and
  handshake protocol) from a SANA configuration file. If you ever want to
  use a different device, unit or baud rate, just change it for your SANA
  device and IPDial will automatically use your new settings.

- own script language: Simple but powerful BASIC-like language. You can,
  for example, scan the input stream for dynamic IP addresses and store them
  in environment variables.

- very small: IPDial is less than 23 KB small and uses very little memory
  while running.

- sample scripts included: Just adapt one of the example scripts to your
  needs. You don't have to write your own programs!

- IPDial is absolutely free of charge with full source code included (see
  the GNU General Public License for details).

- fixed a couple of errors in the documentation (please reread the "Updating"

  moved to the DEVICE command.

Short:    A great PPP device with GUI 1.21
Author:   tbickel@xpoint.at (Thomas Bickel)
Uploader: tbickel@xpoint.at (Thomas Bickel)
Version:  1.21
Type:     comm/net
Replaces: comm/net/AmiPPP12.*
Requires: OS 2.04


This archive contains AmiPPP v1.21, a SANA-II compatible PPP implementation.

It has a built in dialer, features PAP, CHAP (MD5 and MS) and is
easy to use due to the fact that it is *completly* GUI driven.
If you know MacPPP and like it you will also like this one.

Changes since 1.2
-----------------
Added cli argument CONNECT.
Stats get automatically updated now.

Changes since 1.1a
------------------
Added CHAP authentication protocol (MS and MD5). Note that this was not
  fully tested, but a lot of people asked for it so I included it in this
  version. Please report any bugs you find to me.
Added AmiTCP 4.3 installation information.
Added ISDN dialstring (ATDI) to serial config.
Changed IPCP options again. Made 'Addresses' option visible to users
  (will help if you have problems with 0.0.0.0 addresses).
The config file format has changed. You don't need to convert it, but
  don't try to use an older version of AmiPPP with a config file that
  was written with v1.2.

SerPrefs is a 100% replacement for the old Serial prefs util,
It has a modern GUI with hotkeys, and extend far beyond
the original's limitations.

SerPrefs extends several settings/options of the original,
to do this effectivly a new serial.prefs format have been created.
Currently SerPrefs only support the use of a serial device name,
and Sharedmode. Other extensions will be added later.

The new serial.prefs can use prefs by old programs
like the ORIGINAL "Sys:Prefs/Serial" found on the Workbench disks,
and to convert from old to new simply load the old prefs into SerPrefs,
then save it. And that's all you need to do! :-)
Old serial.prefs software will still be able to read the new prefs,
but unable to use the extra information stored.

SerPrefs even show the version of your serial.device,
and have all of the standard prefsmenu items the WB prefs utils have.
Everything is in a single GUI with shortcuts, and is very easy to use.
And you can choose the serial device to use, along with unit number etc.

All normal (plus some extra) baud rates are supported,
along with a buffer range that is more than enough.
It also have separate output/input settings,
for future support or special software.

INSTALLATION
Use the included Installer script, everything is automatic
you only need to chose where to put the documentation.
Even running SerPrefs with the SAVE option is done for you,
so you don't have to start SerPrefs and resave the prefs :-)

FEATURES!
o All normal baud rates (75-921600 Baud)
o Input and Output Buffer (range 0-64 MB)
o Input and Output Xon/Xoff, RTS/CTS
o Sharedmode, selectable device and unit
o Parity Even/Odd/Mark/Space, 5-32 data bits, 0-2 stop bits
o Makes use of custom prefs/serialprefs icons if found.
o All the functions of the original Serial (and then some ;-)
o Locale support and Installer script!

Da li za Amigu postoji ISQ? (ili ICQ)

 Ako da, kako to funkcioniše? Iskustva?

>>  Da li za Amigu postoji ISQ? (ili ICQ)
>>
>>  Ako da, kako to funkcioniše? Iskustva?

Sad postoji. :)

U opticaju su čak dvije verzije, bolje reći dva klona. Naime, iako je o
tome bilo dosta govora, ipak još nije jasno da li će i kada originalni
Mirabilisov ICQ klijent biti portovan na Amigu. Kako princip rada tog
protokola više nije tajna, pojavilo se nekoliko ljudi koji su počeli da
razvijaju svoje verzije.

Prvi, MICQ je prvobitno napisan za UNIX. Source programa je mogao
slobodno da se distribuira, pa je tako dospio i u ruke jednog vlasnika
Amige koji ga je iskompajlirao. Zahtijeva ixemul.library i, naravno, neki
TCP/IP stek. Tekuća verzija je još daleko od pune funkcionalnosti, ali
program se svakodnevno razvija.

Radi se o tekstualnom klijentu koji se startuje isključivo iz komandne
linije i čiji se izlaz dobija isključivo u CLI/Shell prozoru. Na
raspolaganju su najosnovnije funkcije za slanje poruka, autorizaciju i
promjenu statusa. Za sada ne postoji mogućnost registracije iz samog
programa, pa ćete to morati da uradite ili iz verzije za Mac, pod
emulatorom, ili da za vas to uradi neko ko koristi ICQ na PC-u ili
Macintoshu. Osim toga, od važnijih funkcija još uvijek nije implementiran
chat, kao ni opcije za transfer fajlova. UIN i šifra, adresa servera,
aliasi za komande, kao i kontakt lista se čuvaju u tekstualnoj datoteci
.micqrc, u sklopu koje se vrlo jednostavno mogu ažurirati.

Iako je relativno nefleksibilan za rad zbog nedostatka grafičkog
okruženja, ovaj ICQ klon je ipak upotrebljiv. Nezgodno je to što vam u
slučaju veće količine poruka, ako ih na vrijeme ne zaustavite, višak
bespovratno odskroluje sa ekrana, mada bi se i to dalo riješiti nekim
naprednijim shellom koji ima bafer. Autor, na pitanje da li ima namjeru
da napravi GUI, za sada odgovara da nema vremena, a i da ne želi da
konvertuje kod čija se struktura mijenja svakih nekoliko dana, ali da je
siguran da će se već naći neko ko će to učiniti.

Drugi klijent, nazvan DC-GTICQ, izašao je par dana kasnije. Iz imena
se može zaključiti ko ga je preradio za Amigu i distribuirao. ;) U
pitanju je neka interna pre-alpha verzija koja je izbačena da bi se
testirala icqsocks.library, koja se nalazi u sklopu arhive.

Osnovna razlika u odnosu na MICQ je ta što ovaj ima GadTools GUI. U
gornjem dijelu prozora je spisak online korisnika, u srednjem offline
korisnika, a u donjem je spisak komandi. Ima komande za slanje poruke i
URL-a, uspostavljanje i prekidanje veze sa serverom, ikonifikaciju,
autorizaciju korisnika, postavljanje statusa, slanje zahtjeva za
traženjem UIN-a i dodavanje i izbacivanje korisnika iz kontakt liste.
Od svega toga jedino slanje zahtjeva za traženjem UIN-a ne radi.

Konfiguracija se nalazi u dva fajla; u jednom je samo kontakt lista, a u
drugom UIN, šifra i adresa servera. Sve poruke se dobijaju u odvojenim
prozorima koji se trebaju pojedinačno gasiti. Ono što meni lično najviše
nedostaje u odnosu na MICQ je nemogućnost slanje poruke korisniku koji
nije na vezi (zato što da bi mu se poruka poslala, njegov alias mora da
bude selektovan, a to se ne može uraditi ako nema online status), a koja
će da mu se isporuči odmah po prvom konektovanju. Inače, ono što nema
nijedan program, a što bi svakako trebalo stajati visoko na listi
prioriteta 'to do' liste, je zvučna signalizacija promjene statusa
korisnika, trenutka prijema poruke i slično.

U kratkom info fajlu navodi se da je konačna verzija u pripremi i da je
za nju već dizajnirano MUI okruženje. Piše da ima i dosta bagova, ali da
je prilično upotrebljiv, u što sam se i ja uvjerio.

Sve u svemu, zaključak bi bio da, bez obzira što su projekti tek
započeti, nema razloga da ih odmah ne nabavite i koristite. Taman kad
uhvatite malo prakse i kad kao i milioni drugih ljudi širom planete
postanete zavisni o ovom vidu komunikacije preko Interneta, pojaviće
se naprednije i bolje verzije.

Može, ali direktno zavisi od brzine procesora i samog programa koji
koristi serijski port. Device ne igra bitnu ulogu, jer uglavnom svi
koji su u upotrebi mogu da izvuku više od 57600.

Ja, recimo, bez problema pomoću nekih programa mogu da prebacujem podatke
serijskim kablom sa brzinom serijskog porta podešenom na 115200 (mislim
da to možeš postići i ti sa svojom karticom). Međutim, kad radim u
NCommu, s vremena ne vrijeme po neki karakter biva "progutan" u toku
prenosa. Očigledno je da je PhoneWizard veoma ograničen po tom pitanju.

U principu, to što neki program na određenim brzinama radi sa nekim
serijskim device-om, a neki ne, opet je stvar koja se tiče njega samog.
Postoje programi koji bez problema rade sa serial.device-om, a za artser
neće ni da čuju.

    2 - PCI/Zorro III Expansion Slots
    Fast SCSI-II on the motherboard
    Amiga OS v3.2

Optional Items Include:

animation/rendering

include

                                  RAPTOR

   Amiga  4000  je u Americi vrlo usko povezana, i skoro nezamisliva bez
Video  Toastera,  sa  kojim se koristi kao svemoguca video mikseta na TV
stanicama.   Tesko  je  opisati  u  jednoj  recenici  sta je Toster, ali
najjednostavnije     objasnjeno    to    je    graficka    kartica/video
mikseta/digitalizator/dzenlok/3D   ray-tracing  masina  itd.   Real-time
efekti  su  perfektno  brzi  i  predivno  uradjeni.  Kada se dodje do 3D
grafike,  program  LightWave  koji  se dobija uz Toaster ima fantasticne
mogucnosti,  pa  je  zato  i  koriscen  u mnogim komercijalnim filmovima
(Terminator  2, Jurrasic Park) i TV serijama (Babylon 5, Sea Quest) koje
su iziskivale slozene 3D efekte.

      Kako  su  3D animacije koje su tokom godina postavljane pred Amige
bile  sve  slozenije  i duze, pojavio se problem oko brzine iscrtavanja.
Jer,  korisnici su se vremenom razmazili do te mere, da su bez obzira na
kompleksnost  scene zeleli da je iscrtaju za sto krace vreme.  Nekada su
jednostavne scene sa par objekata, na Amigi 500, uzimale i po ceo dan da
se  ray-trace-ovane iscrtaju u tada neverovatnih 4096 boja.  Tehnologija
je,  na srecu, uznapredovala, i danasnje Amige 4000 sa svojim procesorom
68040  krckaju  16  miliona  boja  u  visim rezolucijama za daleko krace
vreme.   Kada  je  Spilberg  resio  da  zapocne  rad na seriji Sea Quest
odlucio  se  da  efekte  rade  Amige  4000  sa  Toasterom.  Sea Quest je
futuristicka  serija  koja  se  odvija  u  naucnoj  stanici  duboko  pod
povrsinom  okeana.   Sve  podvodne  scene kojih je svaka epizoda prepuna
trebalo  je  da budu modelirane i trejsovane u LightWave-u.  Povezano je
petnaestak  Amiga, ali je iscrtavanje i dalje bilo nedovoljno brzo da bi
mogle  da  se naprave sve animacije potrebne za seriju sa novom epizodom
svake   nedelje.   Resenje  Spilbergovog  problema  je  doslo  iz  firme
"DeskStation",  pod  nazivom  Raptor.   Raptor je crna kutija visine oko
80cm  i tezine 35kg u kojoj se nalaze dva R4400 RISC procesora, svaki sa
po  64  Mb  RAM-a!  Ukoliko ni to nije dovoljno, moguce je povezati vise
Raptora  u  sistem  i dobiti brzine od kojih boli glava.  Funkcionisanje
Raptora  je  prilicno jednostavno.  Prvo se poveze Eternet kablom, potom
instalira  softver,  a zatim pocinje sa standardnim radom u LightWave-u.
Kada je zavrseno modeliranje 3D objekata i njihovo postavljanje u scenu,
informacija  se  salje  Raptoru da iscrta sliku.  Moguce je izabrati dve
varijante - da svaki od procesora radi po jednu polovinu iste slike, ili
da  svaki  radi  svoju  sliku.   Druga  varijanta  je  daleko  bolja  za
animacije,  jer se procesori nece cekati ukoliko je jedna polovina slike
kompleksnija  od  druge.  Koliko je Raptor brzi od A4000?  Tacan odgovor
je  nemoguce  dati,  jer  zavisi  od  toga sta se iscrtava, ali jedno je
sigurno  -  srecni  korisnik  ce dobiti ray-trace-ovane slike 10-40 puta
brze   nego   na   najbrzoj  Amigi  4000!   Kao  da  to  nije  dovoljno,
"DeskStation"  nudi  i  Raptor  Plus  koji  poseduje dva brza R4600 RISC
procesora  (133MHz),  sto daje dvostruko vecu brzinu od obicnog Raptora.
Za  sada  je ovu divnu napravu moguce koristiti jedino uz LightWave, ali
su   najavljene  i  verzije  svih  poznatijih  3D  programa  za  Raptor,
ukljucujuci  i  Real3D i Imagine.  Cene su naravno sitnica za Spilbergov
posao,  ali  su  za  obicnog  korisnika  basnoslovne  - Raptor sa 128 Mb
$14000, a Raptor Plus $17000.

stvari pronaćićete i saopštenje za štampu Amiga tech-a glede nedavno
završenog sajma CeBit, na kome je trebalo da bude predstavljen prototip
novog modela Amige :)
      Ukratko, mašinica bi bila u novom, desktop kućištu, imala procesor
68EC030/40 MHZ, dva SIMM podnožja za RAM (proširivo do 128 MB), par slotova
za proširenje... Ostalo čitajte u AR-u :)

vam, po prvi put u vašem gradu - NOVI AMIGA DIREKTORIJUM!!! :))
